purpose: W8-B: replace static Deal 360 scenarios, demo money/provider/document/logistics facts and fixture selectors with one server-backed participant-scoped DealWorkspaceReadModel while preserving the existing composition/design language and never turning projections into command authority.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: W8-B is a read projection and must not collide with W2-C Deal mutation authority.
Money state is read through accepted source facts and cannot be recomputed or mutated by the workspace projection.
Shipment/logistics authority remains source-only; W8-B cannot modify logistics state.
Document authority remains source-only; W8-B cannot fabricate document lifecycle.
Mounting may be handled through an existing read/proxy route or separately bounded wiring; global module mutation is deferred.

requiredInvariants: Deal 360 reads one canonical Deal and participant-scoped related authorities; it never creates DealWorkspace truth independent of Deal/Settlement/Logistics/Documents/Disputes/Trust/Integration evidence.

Static DEAL360_SCENARIOS, canonical fixture selectors, invented provider statuses, invented money amounts and sandbox trip/incidents are removed from production authority paths. A missing source renders MISSING/NOT_READY, never a plausible substitute.

The read model identifies every field/group by source authority, source object id/version/revision and freshness where relevant so users can distinguish facts from projections or external pending states.
Money uses exact canonical minor-unit facts only. No `number`/rub helper, static 9.65m examples or UI recomputation becomes financial authority.

Provider gates display actual IntegrationBinding/capability maturity/receipt state. Named providers that are not activated appear NOT_ACTIVATED/EXTERNAL_BLOCKER, never as selected/available/62-percent tracking fixtures.
Documents display actual canonical document type/version/status/requirement data and cannot manufacture SIGNED/DELIVERED/ACCEPTED from transport or fixture labels.
Logistics/tracking display actual Shipment/provider observation state. Absence of Shipment/track data is explicit and cannot fall back to test route/trip ids.
Next action and blocker explanations are deterministic projections from persisted source facts/versioned policies; UI copy may simplify but cannot change permission or state.
Read access reuses current participant/tenant/organization authority and denies same-tenant outsiders/cross-tenant callers. Staff/privileged visibility remains separately explicit.
The role-specific view can hide irrelevant detail but never hide a blocker/action the role is responsible for. The underlying read model remains complete and source-backed.
Existing Design System v8/tokens/composition are retained while inline/static styling is progressively replaced only where touched; visual refactor must not widen data authority.
Registration, Role Eligibility, W2/W3/W4/W5 command authorities, Federal Accounting lock #4321 and REG.RU production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Static regression proves production Deal 360 imports no `DEAL360_SCENARIOS`, `canonicalDomainDeals` or static domain selectors for authority and contains no fixed production deal/lot/trip/provider money facts.
Server read-model tests prove participant-scoped aggregation across Deal, documents, disputes, logistics, settlement/trust/integration sources and explicit missing-source states.
A provider with no accepted IntegrationBinding/receipt cannot appear live/selected/successful in Deal 360; a real accepted source revision appears with provenance.
Exact money projection matches canonical source minor units and UI formatting only converts for display; no JS floating calculation changes source totals.
Cross-tenant/same-tenant outsider access is denied and revoked participant authority fails on the next read.
E2E covers loading, not-found, missing external source, blocker, active execution, dispute and completed-like read states without fixture fallback.
Mobile/desktop role-specific information hierarchy preserves the same source facts and next-action reason codes.
Exact-head CI/review plus REG.RU server-backed runtime evidence are required before terminal DEAL_360/NO_STATIC_AUTHORITY credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Downstream authorities must be accepted before their Deal 360 sections can be terminally complete.
Full role-specific UX across every cabinet remains W8-A/W8-C/W8-D and human acceptance.
Design-system cleanup outside touched Deal 360 components is not terminally solved by W8-B.
Real-user unaided task acceptance remains ACCEPT-01.
